usedFor: Podio holds your work items, and Google Contacts stores a person through “Create Contact” for each new one.

bestTemplate.name: “New Item Created” in Podio, then “Create Contact” in Google Contacts
bestTemplate.why: A new Podio item becomes a Google contact, so people you track stay in your address book.

watchOut: “New Item Created” in Podio is polling, and the item must carry the details “Create Contact” needs.
